content.title: Fairleigh Dickinson University--Metropolitan Campus Academics & Majors - US News Best Colleges
content.text: The student-faculty ratio at Fairleigh Dickinson University--Metropolitan Campus is 12:1, and the school has 46.6% of its classes with fewer than 20 students. The most popular majors at Fairleigh Dickinson University--Metropolitan Campus include: Liberal Arts and Sciences, General Studies and Humanities; Business, Management, Marketing, and Related Support Services; Health Professions and Related Programs; Psychology; Engineering; Biological and Biomedical Sciences; Homeland Security, Law Enforcement, Firefighting and Related Protective Services; Computer and Information Sciences and Support Services; Multi/Interdisciplinary Studies; and Engineering / Engineering-Related Technologies / Technicians. The average freshman retention rate, an indicator of student satisfaction, is 76%.As a leader in preparing future healthcare professionals, the FDU Health programs foster a collaborative and interdisciplinary environment that encourages innovation, research, and the development of well-rounded professionals who can navigate the complexities of the healthcare landscape. Baccalaureate programs include Clinical Laboratory Sciences, Health Information Management, Health Studies, Medical Imaging Science, Medical Technology, Psychology, Nursing, Radiography, and Radiologic Technology.Learn MoreFind Your Ideal Major, College or CareerDiscover the perfect major for you based on your innate wiring.
